403 Forbidden error when the API key does not have access to the requested resource

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest
from liter_llm import Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
        await client.chat(request)
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
